capabilities: Pull files from a GitHub, GitCode or Gitee repository into the vault
Fetch a whole repo via shallow git clone in full-overwrite mode
Download only changed files in a throttled incremental mode with resume
Filter written files with always-on and custom glob exclusion rules
Access private repositories with platform tokens
disambiguation: Not a two-way git sync tool; it only downloads from the remote repository and never uploads or manages commits and branches.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English UI; manual beta installation path and BRAT install (xcloud-ai/xu-git-pull) are described alongside the recommended community-directory install; token is stored in local data.json and the README warns to use short-lived read-only tokens if the vault is cloud-synced.
intentEvidence: 不适合：移动端也要编辑并同步回电脑（请用 obsidian-git 等双向同步方案）
problem: Two-way git sync plugins are heavyweight on mobile and hosting APIs rate-limit file downloads, so a read-only mobile vault has no cheap way to stay current with a repo pushed from desktop.
